application_rules.RS_rider_integration: Base RS8.2479c excludes USC and EEC; add each once. USC and EEC are added to distribution energy charge. CAP excluded from USC so bounded ordinary model must exclude CAP.
application_rules.GS_rider_integration: EEC appears separately; June2025-May2026 is a negative0.06c/kWh credit. GS has no USC under Rider5.
application_rules.DSIC: Bill-rendered-date basis; total otherwise-applicable distribution rates/charges including clauses/riders, excluding STAS. STAS applies to DSIC. DSIC not part of monthly rate-schedule minimum and minimum not reduced by DSIC.
application_rules.SMC: Per-meter/type monthly charge; STAS applies; not part of monthly rate-schedule minimum. Explicit zero for both types.
application_rules.RMES: Monthly charge; STAS applies. Explicit zero for RS and GS<25kW.
application_rules.taxes: Rider10 STAS and retail sales taxes are independently owned by rules/tax research; do not add GRT again to filed riders.

application_clocks.base: Effective service-date tariff version; matching complete calendar cycles only
application_clocks.universal_service: Residential non-CAP kilowatt-hours delivered during billing month, dated January1 annual version
application_clocks.energy_efficiency: Rate applies to all customers served during any part of a billing month; matching complete calendar cycles select one filed version; no partial-cycle proration inferred
application_clocks.smart_meter: Per-meter monthly charge, applicable to customers served during any part of billing month; current explicit zero
application_clocks.retail_market_enhancement: Per-customer monthly surcharge; current explicit zero
application_clocks.DSIC: Explicit bill-rendered date determines entire bill factor
application_clocks.STAS: All bills rendered; independent rules source confirms rate and base; do not choose service date for a delayed bill
